 By The Macomb Daily | macombdaily@medianewsgroup.com PUBLISHED: November 15, 2026 at 8:15 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Bottle and can drive
 • Woman’s Life Chapter 855 conducts a continuous bottle and can drive with drop off locations in Richmond and Memphis to help those in the community in need. They also offer a pick up service for larger donations. For more information, call 586-260-4318.
 Formal Outfit Drive
 • The Khris Mapp Project is accepting new or gently used formal dresses, suits, pants, shoes, ties and other formal wear along with monetary donations to provide formal outfits for young men and women to ensure that financial circumstances do not prevent them from participating in occasions during the school year. Items are being accepted  through March 1.  For more information or to arrange for item pick up, contact Khris Mapp at 313-721-8456 or email khrismappproject@yahoo.com.
 Historical Museum/ Society events
 • The Washington Historical Museum, 58230 Van Dyke Avenue, Washington Township is open from 1-4 p.m.  Nov 22. There are several rooms that include historical scouting, military, school, and local collections. There are currently displays for the U. S. Bicentennial (1976) and Semiquincentennial (2026). It is managed by the Washington Historical Society, and new members and volunteers are always needed to help with tours, displays, projects, and events. For more information, visit washhistsoc.org , the Greater Washington Area Historical Society Facebook Page, email washingtonmuseum@gmail.com, or call 586-786-5384 (answering machine).
 Medicare enrollment information options
 Open Enrollment for Medicare runs through Dec. 7. The AgeWays MI Options Medicare Assistance Program is offering free, one-on-one Medicare counseling appointments during the Medicare Open Enrollment period. This is a free health care benefit counseling service designed to help Medicare beneficiaries make informed decisions about their coverage. Certified, unbiased counselors can help you:
 • Compare Medicare plan options
• Understand benefits and coverage
• Reduce confusion about Medicare choices
• Find a plan that fits your health care needs and budget
• Explore opportunities to save money on coverage and prescriptions
 Appointments are required by calling 800-852-7795.  To find a location near you, visit ageways.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2026-SHIP-OEP-Events-Calendar-Final-1.pdf 
 Meetings
 • Northeastern Toastmasters meets at 6:45 p.m. on the second and fourth Mondays of the month at Wayne County Community College,19305 Vernier Rd., Harper Woods.
 Mobile Food Pantry
 • Forgotten Harvest Mobile Food Pantry bi weekly from 11 a.m.-2 p.m. Mondays biweekly at 18330 Eastland Street, Roseville. Guests will be able to enter Forgotten Harvest’s mobile food pantry truck using an accessible ramp, use a cart and choose the items they need at no cost. No appointment, pre-registration or ID is needed; distribution will operate on a first-come, first-served basis until all food is distributed.
 Packard Proving Grounds events
 • Wedding garage sale will take place from 1-3 p.m. Nov. 22 at the Packard Proving Grounds, 49965 Van Dyke Avenue, Shelby Township. Cost is $5 per person. More information can be found at packardprovinggrounds.org/event/wedding-garage-sale 
 The Model Train Show will take place at 10 a.m.-3 p.m. Nov. 28 at the Packard Proving Grounds Historic Site, 49965 Van Dyke Ave., Shelby Township. Admission is $5 per person, with children 11 and under admitted free with paid adult admission. For additional information, visit PackardProvingGrounds.org/TrainShow 
 Speaker event
 Two time World Series champion, Major League baseball player and author Scott Spiezio will speak at 6 p.m. Dec. Dec. 3 at University Liggett School, 1045 Cook Road, Grosse Pointe Woods, as part of the Honor Wallace ’22 Memorial Speaker series. Advance registration required at uls.org/speakerseries 
 Widowed friends events
 • Breakfast at 10:30 a.m. Nov. 17 at Pancake Factory, 13693 23 Mile Road, Shelby Township. Host Ellen at 586-489-2569.
 • Lunch at 1:30 p.m. Nov. 18 at Country Inn, 51292 Romeo Plank, Macomb Township, RSVP to event host Fran  at 586-946-7624 by Nov 15, limit 20.
 • Bible Discussion at 10:30 a.m. Nov. 19 at National Coney Island, 30140 Van Dyke, Warren. A 30-minute discussion on a verse from the Old and New Testaments. All Faiths welcome. Dave, the Event Host, is a Stephen Minister. The November verses will be Genesis 7:17-19 and Romans 8:26. Enjoy a meal with separate checks. Questions? Call Event Host Dave W. 586-484-3148.
 • Sunday Movie and lunch Nov. 22, Time TBD by movie at AMC Forum 30 Theater, 44681 Mound Road. Sterling Heights. Call Event Host Pat V. 586-295-2804 by Nov. 19, leave your cell phone number, and she will get in touch with you about movie and time. Lunch to follow, restaurant TBD.
 • Happy Thanksgiving at 2 p.m. Nov. 26 at Roger’s Roost, 33626 Schoenherr, Sterling Heights. Cost is $40.70 per person, tax and gratuity included; beverages extra. RSVP Pat V. 586-295-2804 by Nov 23. Limit 20.
 • Cards, Games and Dominoes noon-3 p.m. Nov. 27 at Mavrix Restaurant 50308 Schoenherr, Shelby Township. Cards, Games, and Dominoes and enjoy a delicious meal.!! Event Host Fran 586-946-7624.
 .• Dancing every Tuesday (no dance Nov. 24) at Polish Century Club, 33204 Maple Lane, Sterling Heights. Doors open at 6 p.m.; music from 7-10:30 p.m. Cost is $10 per person with a cash bar. A table will be reserved for widowed friends. Contact Liz at 586-801-4536.
 Nonprofit and civic organizations that wish to have their events added to Community Spotlight should email information about the event to edit@macombdaily.com. 
 — Macomb Daily staff
